//! The string-free core of the bridge: effect IDs, the effects in flight,
//! and the protocol rules over them. `suite-bridge` holds the effects and
//! results themselves (their text) and re-exports this crate. Verus proves
//! every item here (`proof:bridge`).
#![cfg_attr(not(test), no_std)]
use vstd::prelude::*;

verus! {

/// The most effects a scenario may have in flight at once.
pub const MAX_IN_FLIGHT: usize = 8;

/// Deterministic: the command that requested the effect, and the effect's
/// index in that command's decision.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct EffectId {
    pub command: u32,
    pub index: u8,
}

/// An effect's kind, without its arguments: what `answers` reads.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum EffectKind {
    Spawn,
    WriteFiles,
    FileSize,
    Edit,
    TreeDigest,
    Interrupt,
    MaskPath,
}

/// A result's kind, without its payload.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ResultKind {
    Exited,
    Size,
    Written,
    Text,
    Failed,
}

/// The effects requested and not yet answered, bounded by `MAX_IN_FLIGHT`.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct InFlight {
    slots: [Option<EffectId>; MAX_IN_FLIGHT],
}

// ---- Specification ----
/// What [`answers`] computes: a process gives an exit, a write `Written`,
/// a size query a size, the rest a text, and any may fail.
pub open spec fn answers_spec(effect: EffectKind, result: ResultKind) -> bool {
    match (effect, result) {
        (_, ResultKind::Failed) => true,
        (EffectKind::Spawn, ResultKind::Exited) => true,
        (EffectKind::WriteFiles, ResultKind::Written)
        | (EffectKind::Edit, ResultKind::Written) => true,
        (EffectKind::FileSize, ResultKind::Size) => true,
        (EffectKind::TreeDigest, ResultKind::Text)
        | (EffectKind::MaskPath, ResultKind::Text)
        | (EffectKind::Interrupt, ResultKind::Text) => true,
        _ => false,
    }
}

/// Occupied slots among `s[..k]`.
pub open spec fn occupied(s: [Option<EffectId>; MAX_IN_FLIGHT], k: int) -> int
    decreases k,
{
    if k <= 0 {
        0
    } else {
        occupied(s, k - 1) + if s[k - 1] is Some {
            1int
        } else {
            0int
        }
    }
}

impl InFlight {
    /// Whether `id` is in some slot.
    pub closed spec fn has(self, id: EffectId) -> bool {
        exists|i: int| 0 <= i < MAX_IN_FLIGHT && self.slots[i] == Some(id)
    }

    /// How many effects are in flight.
    pub closed spec fn count(self) -> int {
        occupied(self.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int)
    }

    /// The invariant every reachable set keeps: no ID in two slots.
    pub closed spec fn wf(self) -> bool {
        forall|i: int, j: int|
            #![trigger self.slots[i], self.slots[j]]
            0 <= i < j < MAX_IN_FLIGHT && self.slots[i] is Some ==> self.slots[j] != self.slots[i]
    }
}

// ---- Lemmas ----
proof fn lemma_occupied_bounds(s: [Option<EffectId>; MAX_IN_FLIGHT], k: int)
    ensures
        0 <= occupied(s, k),
        k >= 0 ==> occupied(s, k) <= k,
    decreases k,
{
    if k > 0 {
        lemma_occupied_bounds(s, k - 1);
    }
}

/// Setting slot `at` changes the count below `k` by the change in that slot.
proof fn lemma_occupied_set(
    s: [Option<EffectId>; MAX_IN_FLIGHT],
    t: [Option<EffectId>; MAX_IN_FLIGHT],
    k: int,
    at: int,
)
    requires
        0 <= at < MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
        k <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < MAX_IN_FLIGHT && i != at ==> t[i] == s[i],
    ensures
        occupied(t, k) == occupied(s, k) + if at < k {
            (if t[at] is Some {
                1int
            } else {
                0int
            }) - (if s[at] is Some {
                1int
            } else {
                0int
            })
        } else {
            0int
        },
    decreases k,
{
    if k > 0 {
        lemma_occupied_set(s, t, k - 1, at);
    }
}

/// A free slot below `k` means fewer than `k` are occupied.
proof fn lemma_occupied_free(s: [Option<EffectId>; MAX_IN_FLIGHT], k: int, at: int)
    requires
        0 <= at < k <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
        s[at] is None,
    ensures
        occupied(s, k) < k,
    decreases k,
{
    lemma_occupied_bounds(s, k - 1);
    if at < k - 1 {
        lemma_occupied_free(s, k - 1, at);
    }
}

/// No free slot below `k` means all `k` are occupied.
proof fn lemma_occupied_full(s: [Option<EffectId>; MAX_IN_FLIGHT], k: int)
    requires
        0 <= k <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < k ==> s[i] is Some,
    ensures
        occupied(s, k) == k,
    decreases k,
{
    if k > 0 {
        lemma_occupied_full(s, k - 1);
    }
}

// ---- Code ----
fn same(a: Option<EffectId>, id: EffectId) -> (r: bool)
    ensures
        r == (a == Some(id)),
{
    match a {
        Some(b) => b.command == id.command && b.index == id.index,
        None => false,
    }
}

/// Whether `result` is a possible answer to `effect`: a process gives an
/// exit, a write `Written`, a size query a size, and any may fail.
#[must_use]
pub fn answers(effect: EffectKind, result: ResultKind) -> (r: bool)
    ensures
        r == answers_spec(effect, result),
        result is Failed ==> r,
        effect is Spawn ==> (r <==> (result is Exited || result is Failed)),
{
    matches!(
        (effect, result),
        (_, ResultKind::Failed)
            | (EffectKind::Spawn, ResultKind::Exited)
            | (EffectKind::WriteFiles | EffectKind::Edit, ResultKind::Written)
            | (EffectKind::FileSize, ResultKind::Size)
            | (
                EffectKind::TreeDigest | EffectKind::MaskPath | EffectKind::Interrupt,
                ResultKind::Text
            )
    )
}

// Not derived: a derived `Default` has no spec.
#[allow(clippy::derivable_impls)]
impl Default for InFlight {
    fn default() -> (r: Self)
        ensures
            r.wf(),
            r.count() == 0,
            forall|id: EffectId| !r.has(id),
    {
        let r = InFlight { slots: [None;MAX_IN_FLIGHT] };
        proof {
            lemma_occupied_set(r.slots, r.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int, 0);
            assert(occupied(r.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int) == 0) by {
                reveal_with_fuel(occupied, 9);
            }
        }
        r
    }
}

impl InFlight {
    #[must_use]
    pub fn contains(&self, id: EffectId) -> (r: bool)
        ensures
            r == self.has(id),
    {
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < MAX_IN_FLIGHT
            invariant
                i <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
                forall|k: int| 0 <= k < i ==> self.slots[k] != Some(id),
            decreases MAX_IN_FLIGHT - i,
        {
            if same(self.slots[i], id) {
                return true;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
        false
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn len(&self) -> (r: usize)
        ensures
            r == self.count(),
            r <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
    {
        let mut n = 0;
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < MAX_IN_FLIGHT
            invariant
                i <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
                n == occupied(self.slots, i as int),
            decreases MAX_IN_FLIGHT - i,
        {
            proof {
                lemma_occupied_bounds(self.slots, i as int);
            }
            if self.slots[i].is_some() {
                n += 1;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
        proof {
            lemma_occupied_bounds(self.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int);
        }
        n
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> (r: bool)
        ensures
            r == (self.count() == 0),
    {
        self.len() == 0
    }

    /// The protocol: a new effect may be requested when its ID is not in
    /// flight and a slot is free.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn admits(&self, id: EffectId) -> (r: bool)
        ensures
            r == (!self.has(id) && self.count() < MAX_IN_FLIGHT),
    {
        !self.contains(id) && self.len() < MAX_IN_FLIGHT
    }

    /// Records `id`; `false` when it is already in flight or no slot is free.
    pub fn insert(&mut self, id: EffectId) -> (r: bool)
        requires
            old(self).wf(),
        ensures
            final(self).wf(),
            r == (!old(self).has(id) && old(self).count() < MAX_IN_FLIGHT),
            final(self).has(id) == (old(self).has(id) || r),
            final(self).count() == old(self).count() + if r {
                1int
            } else {
                0int
            },
            forall|other: EffectId| other != id ==> final(self).has(other) == old(self).has(other),
    {
        if self.contains(id) {
            return false;
        }
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < MAX_IN_FLIGHT
            invariant
                i <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
                *self == *old(self),
                old(self).wf(),
                !self.has(id),
                forall|k: int| 0 <= k < i ==> self.slots[k] is Some,
            decreases MAX_IN_FLIGHT - i,
        {
            if self.slots[i].is_none() {
                let ghost before = *self;
                self.slots[i] = Some(id);
                proof {
                    lemma_occupied_set(before.slots, self.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int, i as int);
                    lemma_occupied_free(before.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int, i as int);
                    assert(self.slots[i as int] == Some(id));
                    assert forall|a: int, b: int|
                        #![trigger self.slots[a], self.slots[b]]
                        0 <= a < b < MAX_IN_FLIGHT && self.slots[a] is Some implies self.slots[b]
                        != self.slots[a] by {
                        if a == i {
                            assert(before.slots[b] != Some(id));
                        } else if b == i {
                            assert(before.slots[a] != Some(id));
                        }
                    }
                    assert forall|other: EffectId| other != id implies #[trigger] self.has(other)
                        == before.has(other) by {
                        if before.has(other) {
                            let k = choose|k: int|
                                0 <= k < MAX_IN_FLIGHT && before.slots[k] == Some(other);
                            assert(self.slots[k] == Some(other));
                        }
                        if self.has(other) {
                            let k = choose|k: int|
                                0 <= k < MAX_IN_FLIGHT && self.slots[k] == Some(other);
                            assert(before.slots[k] == Some(other));
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
        proof {
            lemma_occupied_full(self.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int);
        }
        false
    }

    /// Forgets `id`; `false` when it was not in flight.
    pub fn remove(&mut self, id: EffectId) -> (r: bool)
        requires
            old(self).wf(),
        ensures
            final(self).wf(),
            r == old(self).has(id),
            !final(self).has(id),
            final(self).count() == old(self).count() - if r {
                1int
            } else {
                0int
            },
            forall|other: EffectId| other != id ==> final(self).has(other) == old(self).has(other),
    {
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < MAX_IN_FLIGHT
            invariant
                i <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
                *self == *old(self),
                old(self).wf(),
                forall|k: int| 0 <= k < i ==> self.slots[k] != Some(id),
            decreases MAX_IN_FLIGHT - i,
        {
            if same(self.slots[i], id) {
                let ghost before = *self;
                self.slots[i] = None;
                proof {
                    lemma_occupied_set(before.slots, self.slots, MAX_IN_FLIGHT as int, i as int);
                    assert forall|k: int| 0 <= k < MAX_IN_FLIGHT implies self.slots[k] != Some(
                        id,
                    ) by {
                        if k > i {
                            assert(before.slots[k] != before.slots[i as int]);
                        }
                    }
                    assert forall|other: EffectId| other != id implies #[trigger] self.has(other)
                        == before.has(other) by {
                        if before.has(other) {
                            let k = choose|k: int|
                                0 <= k < MAX_IN_FLIGHT && before.slots[k] == Some(other);
                            assert(self.slots[k] == Some(other));
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
        false
    }
}

} // verus!
